fulltitle: AMD RX 5600 XT Review – Gaming & Overclocking

comments.text:
Press release driver was used for testing, boost clocks seemed to sit around 1600MHz for this card. 
AMD are going whacky with the vbios for the 5600 XT cards so expect some differing results across reviews.
Enjoy!
comments.author: @optimumtech

comments.text: Does the XFX card in the review fit in the Ghost S1?
comments.author: @AxelEkwall

comments.text: AMD released a bios update that increases power limits and vram speed, did you test with the new bios?
comments.author: @Phanbot01

comments.text: will you test the new vbios? seems to give some very interesting results. outperforms the RTX 2060 in some games
comments.author: @naynay4058

comments.text: @naynay4058  Yeah exactly. I believe we need a retest. (:
comments.author: @WarriorsPhoto

comments.text: @naynay4058  Hardware Unboxed compared both vbios against the 2060 and found that the updated vbios on the rx 5600 xt is exactly identical in terms of performance on average across 12 games, while the first vbios is about 10-15 % slower or something I can't remember exactly
comments.author: @davidmorling1264

comments.text: @davidmorling1264  Just watched that video before. Love hardware unboxed. Yeah no reason for 2060 now the 5600xt matches or beats it.
comments.author: @jimmyjango5213

comments.text: Exactly what i would have said, some users with the new bios are having much better results closing even the rtx 2060 , after watching this comparison i was really confused.
comments.author: @iTechGamingLOL

comments.text: @iTechGamingLOL  blame amd
comments.author: @halistinejenkins5289

comments.text: Yea, this looks to be like a baseline 5600xt performance, not with the updated bios. Maybe your model doesnt support the new bios, in which I wouldn't recommend this card.  Definitely get a card with the higher TDP support because it competes with the 2060 instead of the 1660ti for the same price.  Thanks for the video though, definitely check with your supplier for a bios update.

comments.text: Got this exact card a few days ago for $359 CDN ($249 US). Did a few benchmarks before and after the VBIOS update. XFX site claims a 7% increase with new BIOS. Ryzen 5 2600X, 16GB 3200 CL14 DDR4. I saw a 3.5-4% gain. Timespy was 6707 and Rise of the Tomb Raider was 93.7fps w/ old BIOS. 6977 and 97.7fps w/ new BIOS. No 7% gains there. Base clock is up from 1460 to 1560. Max clock up from 1642 to 1753. 100W max draw on the old BIOS, 114W max on the new BIOS. Saw jumps to 130W in Lobby screen in COD Warzone. Getting 120-140 FPS in that game on High Settings. Temps have never gone over 89C junction, or 79C GPU. Have not tried any overclocking. Hope this helps. Good upgrade from my GTX 1060 3GB. Double FPS in most games on higher quality settings.
